meta.titre: The first conditional: realistic future results

sections.contenu_markdown: The first conditional talks about real possibilities in the future: if the condition happens, the result WILL happen.
If + present simple, ... will + base verb. This structure expresses a realistic or likely future consequence of a present or future condition.
sections.formule_principale: If + present simple, ... will + base verb

sections.enonce_markdown: Complete: If you take this drug you ... well (be).
sections.conclusion_markdown: If you take this drug you will be well.

items.pourquoi_faux: 'Would' belongs to the second conditional (hypothetical, unreal present), not to a realistic future prediction like this one.
items.correction_markdown: Match 'if + present simple' with 'will + base verb' for realistic future conditions.

items.enonce_markdown: Complete: If it rains, we ... (stay) at home.

items_markdown: First conditional = If + present simple, will + base verb
